+    lo, hi = s.low.model.actuator_ctrlrange.T
+    return np.clip((2.0 * q - lo - hi) / (hi - lo), -1, 1)
+

+def make_trajectory(s):

+    q0 = s.low.data.qpos[7:26].copy()
+    qsit = q0.copy()
+    qsit[[2, 7]] = 0.32       # hip pitch
+    qsit[[3, 8]] = 1.45       # knees
+    qsit[[4, 9]] = -0.42      # ankles
+    qsit[10] = 0.0            # torso

+        u = u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
